notes: Inbound from docs-search blog post / demo page — signed up via hosted API self-serve trial on 2026-03-01.
Company overview: small legal-tech SaaS that builds internal knowledge bases and answer assistants for boutique law firms. Index size currently ~120k docs (contracts, memos, pleadings).
Primary ask: replace current Pinecone + open-source embedding pipeline with hosted embeddings + lightweight reranking in front of vector DB to increase relevance and reduce token cost.
Latency & throughput: typical query load 5-15 qps; peak ~50 qps during working hours. Goal: 95th pctile end-to-end < 500ms for short queries, tolerates 1s for complex RAG flows.
Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; exploring hosted API because they want zero infra ops. Looking at embeddings cost and per-token generation for reranker/cross-encoder tradeoffs.

Model preferences: prefer open-model embeddings first (affordable), willing to test Redwood-verified small text-embedding models. Interested in recommendations for reranker (cross-encoder) vs lightweight lexical rerank.
Security: require SSO/SAML for team access, SOC2 attestation required, audit logs for API access. No data residency requirement (US only fine).
Stack notes from discovery call (2026-03-03, Maya/Diego): currently using Postgres for metadata, Pinecone for vectors, Node backend. They push new documents nightly via a batch job.
Key quote from CTO: "We need better relevance on legal clauses — lawyers reject results even if semantically close. If reranking boosts quality, we'll convert from POC to paid quickly."

POC proposal: 2-week hosted API POC. Week 1: embeddings baseline (100k docs) + simple nearest-neighbor. Week 2: add reranking step (cross-encoder via Redwood hosted_api) and measure reply quality + cost. Deliverables: eval set (50 queries), MAP/NDCG numbers, latency and cost per query estimates.

Technical questions raised on call: how to stream embedding updates to Pinecone; best practices for prefix/KV caching to reduce tokens on rerank stage; options to use embeddings-only search vs hybrid retrieval + rerank; sample SDKs for Node + Python.
Objections: wants SOC2 before enabling production keys; also wants rough monthly cost estimate at projected 2M tokens/month (embeds + rerank tokens combined).
Admin: trial account created by Head of Product (elena@labyrinthscribe.com). They used free credits and already ingested a 5k doc sample via the SDK.

Action items assigned: Maya to send quickstart + reranking sample by 2026-03-05 (done). Diego to provide sample eval harness and small script to replay queries. Follow-up call tentatively 2026-03-12 (moved to 2026-03-15).
